lots.guide_summary: Only one surviving close entry: a near-identical wooden and brass star-back made $90 hammer at Gowans in June 2026 (SOLD). Wider category evidence is lower: a UK starback at GBP 22 (about AUD 42, SOLD, rate 1.9168) and ordinary reel lots at $25 to $45 hammer in Hobart. No verified UNSOLD or ASKING entries; an Etsy AU$90.25 asking price is a snippet-only lead. The creel adds perhaps $10 to $30 based on the weak Gowans mixed-lot result.
lots.working: Keep: lowest (only) surviving close SOLD = $90 hammer; 90 / 1.22 = 73.77, round down to $70 (all-in $85.40). Flip: likely resale for reel plus creel about $100 (reel $70 to $90 on the Gowans result, creel $10 to $30); less 15% selling fees ($15) and $20 outbound postage = $65; 65 / 2.44 = 26.6, round down to $25. The $90 result looks at the top of the range against the $25 to $45 local reel lots and the GBP 22 UK hammer, so treat $70 as a firm ceiling, not a target.
lots.confidence_reason: MARLIN stamp read on the crossplate and the identification is clear, but only one close SOLD entry (opened, photo checked); other sold evidence is category only and lower.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped: ebay.de/itm/256907457065 GBP 24.31 'SOLD' (snippet only, eBay closed to us, cannot verify price, date or that it sold). Dropped: eBay Australia shop page AU$139 / AU$449.99 (snippet only, search listing page, unverifiable, asking). Dropped: eBay US creel page US$30 to US$175 (snippet only, unverifiable, overseas asking). Easy Live GBP 22 kept after the page was opened and the hammer and 12 April 2026 date confirmed. Researcher's GBP rate of 2.0 corrected to 1.9168.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 4: brass four-arm crossplate clearly stamped MARLIN, screw-fixed, brass foot; timber face has a small chip or burn mark near the check button. Photo 5: reverse with brass centre plate and two brass-mounted handle knobs, concentric line decoration on the timber. No line on the spool. Creel: woven cane, hinged lid with peg catch, leather strap with buckle; inside looks sound, lid weave slightly loose at one side.
lots.condition: Reel: used, timber sound with light wear and one small chip near the check button, brass dull but complete. Creel: good used, minor loose weave on lid, strap present.
lots.question_for_armitage: Does the reel spin freely with the check working, are there any cracks to the timber drum, and is anything else stamped on the reel (size, maker, country) besides MARLIN?
